issue.title: Self-service page is advertised for reception but its workspace cannot be opened
issue.actual: demo.reception GET /meta/handbook lists self_service in My Workspace with view full, and the screen bundle roles.full/page_for include receptionist. GET /auth/workspaces returns only reception; GET /meta/handbook?workspace=self_service answers403 FORBIDDEN Not one of your workspaces. The app correctly cannot offer/open a workspace absent from auth/workspaces, so the self-service named asset picker cannot be exercised through the normal app by this advertised actor.
issue.expected: Keep the advertised full/page_for roles and authorized workspace catalogue consistent, or document the intended contextual route. Supply a permitted demo actor/route to exercise self_service without inventing a workspace or changing roles locally.
issue.steps: Fresh backend7429acf: as demo.reception GET /meta/handbook; GET /auth/workspaces; GET /meta/handbook?workspace=self_service. UI Workspaces offers only Reception & Front Desk. No business writes in reproduction.
